reusable.what: A small WebGL2 renderer without three.js: signed-distance shapes, ribbons and glyph quads into a linear half-float target, sub-frames averaged for motion blur, then bloom, a tone curve, vignette, dither and grain; stateless per frame
A glyph atlas rasterised once on a CPU canvas at display size, with its own measuring and layout: deterministic type of any size, drawn as quads in a WebGL scene
A pure perspective camera rig in reference pixels that looks at a point on a stack of horizontal planes from a tilt
Progress windows, gates and bumps on a frame grid, and the entrance and exit state of a line of type from a cue sheet

One timeline for picture, score, captions and hold tests: lines of type on a 120 bpm grid with tiers, blocks and hand-over, hits and hold cues (with cues.test.ts, its reading-time and one-block-at-a-time rules)
